text:
Ravi (PM): heads-up  need a decision on "banded quotas" + predictive prewarm behavior for Dedicated pools. customers want fairness during global events and fewer cold-start surprises.
Mei (Eng): quick sketch: introduce quota bands (small/medium/large) with per-band fairness weights. Predictive prewarm only fires for medium+ based on historical surge signals. keeps infra cost down.
Diego (SRE): ops constraints: predictive prewarm increases background GPU warmups. we need a soft throttle guard so prewarm doesn't evict active work. also require an emergency toggle to disable prewarm globally.
Anya (Sales): customers like the banded idea if they can map to SKUs. they also asked for regional priority (APAC customers want reserved headroom in APAC zones).
Ben (Billing): billing ask: show band_id and prewarm_charge_flag in exports. prewarming should be billable as part of burst or as separate prewarm fee? we need clarity for invoicing.
Mei (Eng): API proposal:
```
PATCH /v1/tenants/:id/quota
{ "band": "medium", "fairness_weight": 1.2, "predictive_prewarm": {"enabled": true, "lookback_min": 60, "threshold_risk": 0.7}, "regional_priority": ["us-west-2","eu-central-1"] }
```
Ravi (PM): decision points: 1) default bands and weights, 2) whether predictive prewarm billable by default, 3) default regional behavior.
Diego (SRE): recommend defaults: band=small for new tenants, predictive_prewarm disabled by default (opt-in), regional_priority inherits tenant region only. That reduces unexpected infra cost.
Anya (Sales): Sales request: offer a "prewarm add-on" for customers running events; they pay for prewarm minutes. Makes revenue sense.
Ben (Billing): OK to bill prewarm as an add-on. Need exported fields: prewarm_minutes, prewarm_band_id, prewarm_invoice_code. Also must produce daily rolls to avoid surprise monthly invoices.
Mei (Eng): implementation notes: admission checks fairness_weight * effective_tokens to decide scheduling priority. predictive prewarm uses a lightweight predictor on request-rate spikes; when predictor > threshold, enqueue prewarm job but respect prewarm_capacity_limit. prewarm jobs tag model cache entries so requests can warm KV faster.
Diego (SRE): test plan: 1) scale-surge test with multiple bands to validate priority ordering, 2) prewarm stress test to ensure background jobs don't reduce throughput, 3) regional failover test to ensure regional_priority honored.
Ravi (PM): launch criteria: API + console controls, billing export with prewarm fields, opt-in prewarm add-on flow, emergency global prewarm disable button, and the 3 tests Diego listed.
Anya (Sales): comms: add FAQ explaining prewarm billing and expected latency improvements (and limits). sample contract line: "Prewarm add-on: billed per-minute; does not guarantee zero cold-start latency."
Ben (Billing): acceptance: generate sample invoice for event with both burst tokens and prewarm minutes. finance approval required before GA.
Mei (Eng): risk notes: predictor false positives -> wasted GPU cycles; predictor false negatives -> missed prewarm. mitigate by conservative default (disabled) and 1-week beta for opt-ins.
Diego (SRE): operational mitigations: prewarm quota pool with hard cap per-region, and alert if prewarm consumption > 10% of region capacity for 1h. add circuit-breaker metrics.
Ravi (PM): decision: implement bands + fairness weights + regional_priority. predictive prewarm as opt-in add-on (beta) with billing fields. default: small band, prewarm off. launch checklist = Mei's API + Diego tests + Ben's billing exports.
Mei (Eng): timeline: planning -> 2 sprints for core quota bands and fairness scheduler; separate 1 sprint for prewarm additive and billing hooks; we can pilot prewarm with 2 customers after GA.
ops-bot: created RFC DCR-5789: "banded-quotas + opt-in predictive prewarm (regional priority)" and linked to roadmap board.
Ravi (PM): thanks. Mei/Diego to break tickets. Sales/Billing to prepare customer comms and invoice samples. reconvene after sprint planning. :rocket:
